notes: Plan-only evals grade strict direct review. Each operation resolves once into a retained ResolvedProject; refusal is fatal and no policy is defaulted or inferred.

evals.name: plan-review-direct-command-and-capability
evals.prompt: At from-issue Phase 5, plan-review is ready. Plan-only: explain selection, direct invocation, validation, failure handling, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. Select bindings.workflow.review.plan, capabilities.review.plan, and bindings.commands[review_id]; a refusal is fatal. blocked stops with its reason and repair ID; unsupported takes the documented native route. For available, preserve base argv/cwd/env and append `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`, sending the complete packet on stdin. Keep JSONL and last-message candidates under TMPDIR with unconditional cleanup. Validate every JSONL object, selected model gpt-6-astra, selected reasoning effort xhigh, exactly one terminal agent-message, and byte equality with the non-empty last-message before Blocking / Should fix / Discussion establish Codex. A daemon, slot, or capacity rejection stops verbatim with no retry and no native fallback. A completed non-capacity runtime, metadata, output, or schema failure takes exactly one native fallback with the same packet. The parent verifies and dispositions findings without storing the raw transcript.

evals.name: diff-review-light-packet-boundaries
evals.prompt: sdd dispatches diff-review over abc1234..def5678. Plan-only: state the packet, output, route, and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject and select bindings.workflow.review.code, capabilities.review.code, and bindings.commands[review_id]. A fatal refusal or blocked capability stops; unsupported uses the documented native route. The light packet contains operation/worktree/base/head, correctness-only scope, rubric path, manifest metrics and plan routing path, verification context and instruction chain, and matching standards; it excludes conformance material. Invoke the direct command with the exact argv augmentation `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`. Validate JSONL selected model and selected reasoning effort, one terminal agent-message, last-message byte equality, then Critical / Important / Minor. Return the validated result and scope to the controller. Capacity rejection stops verbatim with no retry or native fallback; one non-capacity completed failure gets the same-packet native fallback.

evals.name: diff-review-oversized-range-scoped-packet
evals.prompt: diff-review sees 44 product files. Plan-only: explain scope, direct review validation, and error routes.
evals.expected_output: After selecting bindings.workflow.review.code from the retained ResolvedProject, run the existing size pre-flight from the resolved artifact paths. A 44-file range scopes to 20 paths, preserves the manifest metrics without reading shards, and adds literal per-path diff collection and coverage. The exact direct argv augmentation is `exec --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --json --output-last-message <absolute-last-message> --ephemeral -C <absolute-worktree> -`. Validate JSONL selected model gpt-6-astra and selected reasoning effort xhigh, exactly one terminal agent-message, non-empty last-message byte equality, and Critical / Important / Minor. A capacity rejection stops verbatim with no retry or native fallback; an unavailable measurement is unmeasured, while a completed non-capacity runtime/output/schema failure gets one same-packet native fallback. No default or inference is allowed.
